usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia, daily buying and selling rates, 31 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid-point of the CBL buying (169.4404) and selling (171.4896) rates for 31 October 2026; World Bank 2024 average 191.3. CLDR gives '$'; 'L$' is used to tell it apart from the US dollar, which also circulates widely.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia, Monetary Policy Committee Communique No. 28, 6 October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Headline inflation moderated to an estimated 4.5% in the third quarter of 2026 from 5.4% in the second quarter; the CBL expects about 4.6% in the fourth quarter. Trading Economics shows the LISGIS figure at 5.0% for June 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation for Liberia (8.3% in 2025); CBL MPC Communique No. 28 (4.5% in Q3 2026)
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has fallen to about 4.5% with a stronger Liberian dollar, but averaged 7-10% over 2021-2025, so 6.5% is used for long plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia, Monetary Policy Committee Communique No. 28, 6 October 2026
policy_rate.note: Monetary Policy Rate kept at 16.0% (cut from 16.25% in July 2026); the reserve requirement on US dollar deposits was raised from 10% to 12%.

savings_account_rate.note: No official current savings account rate was found; the Central Bank of Liberia publishes no recent table of commercial bank deposit rates that could be read (World Bank average deposit rate 3.80% for 2025).

fdr_3m_rate.note: No official 3-month time deposit rate was found in Central Bank of Liberia publications.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No official 1-year time deposit rate was found in Central Bank of Liberia publications.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 3.80% for 2025: average paid by commercial banks on demand, time and savings deposits; most deposits in Liberia are in US dollars.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond with a published rate was found; a central bank savings programme for citizens has been reported but its details could not be read.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No recent Government of Liberia 91-day Treasury bill result was found. For reference, the 3-month Central Bank of Liberia bill (a central bank instrument bid by banks, not a Treasury bill and not open to individuals) cleared at 15.12% on 24 September 2026 (CBL bills issuance report).

tbond_5y_rate.note: No Government of Liberia 5-year bond yield was found in Central Bank of Liberia publications.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No Government of Liberia 10-year bond yield was found; Liberia has no domestic long-term government bond market with published yields.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Liberia, individual income determination and withholding taxes
tax_bank_interest.note: Non-exempt interest is taxed at 15% and interest paid to residents is subject to 15% withholding (PwC corporate withholding page); interest under LRD 200 a year is excluded. Page last reviewed 24 September 2026.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; interest is generally taxed at 15% (PwC Tax Summaries).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No operating deposit insurance scheme was found; the Central Bank of Liberia has spoken of plans for a Deposit Insurance Scheme, but no law or cover limit was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or official average credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025); no stock exchange in Liberia
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Liberia has no stock exchange, so equity means a global index fund in Liberian-dollar terms; a weak decade abroad with a stable currency gives about the after-tax deposit rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025), 3.2% after 15% tax; no stock exchange in Liberia
equity_return_base.note: Base case: a global equity index in Liberian-dollar terms, held to the after-tax average deposit rate (3.2%) plus 4 points because there is no local index record and individuals cannot buy central bank bills.

equity_return_high.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate LRD per USD (191 in 2024, 170 in October 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equity returns plus a renewed depreciation episode like 2018-2020.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia buying and selling rates (L$169-171 per US$, October 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a stable Liberian dollar, as in 2025-2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate LRD per USD
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus Liberian-dollar depreciation of about 2% a year.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate LRD per USD
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and a depreciation episode like 2018-2020, when the Liberian dollar lost about a quarter of its value.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025), 3.2% after 15% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: average deposits after 15% tax, allowing for lower rates.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025), 3.2% after 15% withholding
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: about the average deposit rate after tax (3.2%), slightly higher for Liberian-dollar time deposits; individuals cannot buy central bank bills directly.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia bills report, 3-month bill 15.12% (24 September 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: Liberian-dollar time deposits priced partly off the 15-16% money market rates, after 15% tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Central Bank of Liberia supervises insurers but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published indicative term-life premium rates per 1,000 Liberian dollars of cover from the regulator or another public source were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums per 100,000 Liberian dollars of cover from the regulator or another public source were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation for Liberia; CBL MPC Communique No. 28
goal_inflation_health.note: No health CPI series could be read, so medical costs are planned at one point above the 6.5% general assumption, as drugs and supplies are imported.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation for Liberia; CBL MPC Communique No. 28
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series could be read, so school fees are planned at one point above the 6.5% general assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)
life_expectancy.note: 62.3 years in 2024 (men 61.0, women 63.6); UN WPP 2024 gives 62.6 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.79 (2025, World Bank), 6.4 (2040) and 9.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/liberia/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: WageIndicator Foundation summary of the NASSCORP Social Security Law 2017 (s.89) and Decent Work Act 2015
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension at 60 for men and women with at least 144 months of contributions; a lump sum at 60 with 12 or more months; retirement deemed at 65. Page updated 19 March 2026.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Liberia news item citing Civil Service Agency standing orders and the Government Employees Pension Act
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants retire at 65 or after 25 years of service (Civil Service Agency standing orders); the item is from 2017 (older than 2025) and no later change was found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025), 3.2% after 15% withholding
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: average deposits after tax, allowing for lower rates.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate 3.80% (2025), 3.2% after 15% withholding
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: savings and time deposits at about the 3.2% after-tax average deposit rate; individuals cannot buy central bank bills directly.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia bills report, 3-month bill 15.12% (24 September 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: more Liberian-dollar time deposits at rates linked to the 15-16% money market.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits with little growth exposure.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: World Bank WDI deposit rate; CBL bills report (September 2026)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of time deposits and foreign equity funds, between the safe and equity base cases.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Liberia bills report (3-month 15.12%); World Bank exchange rate history
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: higher-yield Liberian-dollar deposits and more foreign equity.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension with a fixed monthly amount was found; the social cash transfer programme targets poor households, not older people as such, and the social protection ministry pages could not be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: The Decent Work Act 2015 (s.14.5, s.18.4) gives severance of 4 weeks' pay per completed year of service when employment ends for economic reasons (redundancy, closure), per WageIndicator; no general end-of-service or retirement gratuity was found.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: NASSCORP General Regulations 2023 (Schedule I, contribution rates); WageIndicator summary of the Social Security Law 2017
public_pension_scheme.note: National Pension Fund run by NASSCORP: employer and employee each pay 4% of earnings (since 13 February 2017); pension at 60 with 144 months of contributions, 25% of average monthly earnings plus 1% per extra 10 months up to 40% (WageIndicator, updated March 2026). No automatic indexation or tax rule was found.

savings_account.note: Offered in Liberian and US dollars; no official average rate published recently.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take time deposits; no official rate by maturity was found.

fdr_1y.note: No official rate by maturity was found.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond with a published rate was found.

tbill_91d.note: Government of Liberia Treasury bill auctions are open only to commercial banks, which may hold bills for clients (2010 CBL guidelines, minimum non-competitive bid L$50,000); recent auctions are mainly central bank bills.

tbond_5y.note: No domestic 5-year government bond open to individuals was found.

tbond_10y.note: No domestic 10-year government bond was found.

equity_fund.note: Liberia has no stock exchange and no locally regulated retail investment funds were found.

gold.note: No retail market for investment gold bars or coins was found.

insuranceRegulator.name: Central Bank of Liberia (insurance supervision under the Insurance Act 2013)

insuranceComplaints.name: Central Bank of Liberia, insurance supervision
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman was found; complaints go to the Central Bank as insurance supervisor.

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security and Welfare Corporation (NASSCORP)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (free primary care at public facilities)
publicHealthCover.note: No national health insurance scheme in operation was found.

statistics.name: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
